title: Agentic Personalized Fashion Recommendation in the Age of Generative AI: Challenges, Opportunities, and Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: The paper conceptually identifies dataset imbalances where dominant fashion categories and items overshadow rare attributes, proposing ensemble rankers with adaptive re-weighting to evaluate and boost recall for underrepresented items.

The paper proposes a conceptual 'Business Logic Critic' module within an agentic LLM framework that dynamically evaluates and filters generated fashion recommendations to ensure equitable visibility and fairness among different brands.
